headlines.title: US interest rates raised for first time in three years
headlines.summary: Rates were hiked in a unanimous decision despite fierce opposition from President Donald Trump, who had called for a cut.

headlines.title: France: TotalEnergies cut-price fuel spikes controversy among rivals
headlines.summary: TotalEnergies service stations are accused of distorting competition as they display France's lowest-priced fuel. Supermarkets that usually sell fuel as a loss leader to pull in customers are furious, along with independent service stations.

headlines.title: DW
headlines.summary: News, Analysis and Service from Germany and Europe - in 30 Languages

headlines.title: What AI urgency? Industry and leaders split on how to handle advanced tech’s threats
headlines.summary: Conversations among lawmakers, tech executives and industry experts at the POLITICO Decoded Summit showed the long road toward reaching a consensus on addressing AI’s potentially existential risks.

headlines.title: Petrol and diesel price rises push UK inflation higher
headlines.summary: Summer holidays and disruption to global oil supplies by the Middle East conflict stoked price growth.

headlines.title: Exein becomes unicorn: Italian Physical AI security start-up valued at $1.7bn
headlines.summary: Rome-based startup Exein raises $270 million, reaching a $1.7 billion valuation. The company secures Physical AI, protecting over 1.5 billion connected devices across multiple industries.

headlines.title: Why the era of cheap government debt is over
headlines.summary: US debt has topped $40 trillion. How risky is the country s growing debt burden. And will investors keep funding Washington s deficits?

headlines.title: Left on brink of victory in Swedish election
headlines.summary: Defeat looms for Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson and his allies on the far right.

headlines.title: Henry Zeffman: Andy Burnham and his chancellor have a battle on their hands as the Budget approaches
headlines.summary: The Budget is only six weeks away and the economy is undoubtedly the biggest challenge facing the prime minister.

headlines.title: Why this fast-growing German AI start-up is moving its parent company from the US
headlines.summary: In a highly unusual move, fast-growing German AI start-up Langdock has moved its legal headquarters from the US to Germany as it seeks to become a European hyperscaler .

headlines.title: Why AI researchers warn humanity could face extinction
headlines.summary: Could artificial intelligence pose an existential threat to humanity? Some leading researchers are warning against an unregulated race toward AI superintelligence.

headlines.title: ‘The US can’t lose’: Pentagon plows ahead on AI despite warnings
headlines.summary: Military leaders warn the risks of falling behind adversaries in artificial intelligence research outweigh the potential risks of the technology.

headlines.title: OpenAI boss says world 'right to be afraid' but should trust AI firms
headlines.summary: Sam Altman and other tech CEOs say there are incentives to limit advancements in AI, as fears grow over the threats it poses to humanity.

headlines.title: Earning more is not enough: house prices in Spain rise faster than wages
headlines.summary: Annual pay differs by about €10,000 between Spanish regions, but a 90-square-metre home can cost up to €383,000 more. In the Balearic Islands and Madrid, buyers need more than €129,000 saved for the deposit and other upfront costs.

headlines.title: Africa s richest man Dangote s IPO out of reach in Nigeria
headlines.summary: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery s capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?

headlines.title: US central bank hikes interest rates and signals more to come, defying Trump
headlines.summary: Central bankers are increasingly worried that inflation — worsened by soaring oil prices and an AI investment boom — is not on a path back to their 2% target.

headlines.title: We managed to get jobs after uni - here's how we're keeping them
headlines.summary: Four recent job starters share their tips on what helped them have a smooth transition and survive their first few days.

headlines.title: No comment from Riyadh on oil delivery cancellations as scale of disruption remains unclear
headlines.summary: The pipeline shutdown has put pressure on Saudi oil supplies to Europe as further conflict in the region threatens shipping routes. Riyadh has yet to comment on reports that some refiners face delays until November.

headlines.title: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?
headlines.summary: Iran is shifting trade toward northern ports and land routes as its southern shipping faces a US blockade. Analysts say the corridors can keep essential goods moving, but cannot replace maritime trade.

headlines.title: EU blindsided by von der Leyen s Canada associate member pitch
headlines.summary: The Commission president unveiled the idea without consulting EU capitals — and Ottawa quickly tamped down expectations.

trend_headline: 중동 발 원유 공급 차질과 AI 규제 강화의 충돌
summary: 중동 분쟁으로 인한 글로벌 원유 공급 차질과 파이프라인 셔다운 우려가 인플레이션 압력을 높이는 가운데, 유럽연합(EU)은 AI 챗봇과 소셜미디어 규제를 전방위로 확대하며 빅테크 섹터를 압박하고 있습니다. 한편 이탈리아의 Exein이 17억 달러 밸류로 유니콘에 등극하는 등 물리적 AI 보안 분야는 독자적인 성장 모멘텀을 유지하고 있습니다.
key_points: 중동 지역 분쟁 및 파이프라인 셔다운으로 유럽의 원유 수급 불안과 인플레이션 압력 가중
유럽연합 집행위원회, 15세 미만 아동의 소셜미디어 접근 제한 및 AI 챗봇 안전 규제 추진
이탈리아 물리적 AI 보안 스타트업 Exein, 2억 7천만 달러 조달하며 17억 달러 밸류로 유니콘 등극
